raw_prompt: Implement password reset session invalidation that blacklists active refresh tokens across all clusters.

password reset.rationale: Security workflow and event triggering account credentials update.

session invalidation.rationale: State transition and revocation action on active user sessions.

blacklist.rationale: Action of adding revoked tokens or session identifiers to a denial registry.

across all clusters.rationale: Distributed architectural boundary constraint mandating multi-region/multi-cluster synchronization.

token blacklist.rationale: Domain data structure and aggregate store holding revoked token identifiers.
